title: Rosemary Beach: Soleil in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Soleil in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to Soleil, a sophisticated one-bedroom, two-bathroom condo perfectly situated above the vibrant main street of Rosemary Beach. This stylish retreat offers stunning views of the Gulf of Mexico from the living room and a convenient location amidst boutique shops and gourmet restaurants.

Step into the open-concept living space where the kitchen seamlessly flows into the living area, creating a bright and welcoming environment. The fully-equipped kitchen features modern appliances and everything you need to prepare delicious meals. The adjoining living room is a cozy spot to relax, complete with comfortable seating and large windows that fill the space with natural light. Step out onto the balcony, where you can enjoy the fresh sea breeze and take in the lively atmosphere of Rosemary Beach below.

The spacious bedroom provides a serene retreat with plush bedding and ample storage, while the two well-appointed bathrooms offer luxurious fixtures and thoughtful amenities to enhance your stay.

As a guest of Soleil, you'll have access to an array of exclusive Rosemary Beach amenities. Stay active at the Rosemary Beach Fitness Center or enjoy a game at the Rosemary Beach Racquet Club. Take a dip in one of the four community pools or relax on the private beaches reserved for Rosemary Beach residents and guests.

Immerse yourself in the local culture with easy access to unique boutiques, art galleries, and a variety of dining options just steps from your door. Enjoy outdoor adventures such as biking, paddleboarding, and scenic walks along the beach and nature trails. Explore nearby attractions like Camp Helen State Park and the lively farmers' markets.

Soleil is the perfect spot for a romantic getaway, a solo retreat, or a relaxing vacation in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Experience the charm and elegance of this beautiful coastal town from the comfort of our luxurious condo. Book your stay today and start creating unforgettable memories!
